sections.title: What Is a Program?
sections.text: A program is a sequence of instructions that specifies how to perform a computation.

sections.title: Running Python
sections.text: You can run Python in an interpreter, which lets you type a statement and see the result immediately.

sections.title: Values and Types
sections.text: A value is one of the basic things a program works with, like a letter or a number.
